meaning: To walk around slowly, with no special place to go.
mean_say: to walk around slowly, with no special place to go.
example: We wandered around the old town all afternoon.
ex_say: We wandered around the old town all afternoon.
note: Stress on the 1st syllable. "wan" sounds like "wahn".
note_say: The stress is on the first syllable. The a sounds like ah, so it's wahn-der, not wonder.
tip: Your mind can wander too: you stop paying attention.
tip_say: Your mind can wander too. It means you stop paying attention.
vn_tip: “wander” (/ɑ/, miệng mở rộng) khác “wonder” (/ʌ/): đừng nhầm hai từ.
vn_tip_say: Wander has an open ah sound. Wonder has a short uh sound. Don't mix them up.
scene: Little houses on a winding old-town lane at golden hour, with a walker slowly passing, lanterns glowing and birds drifting.
